measurement: HTTP request to complete base64 PNG response. Mean/min/max of measured seeds only; warmups excluded. Complete cells have three measured seeds. No averaging across configurations.
historical_results: Measurements made before the cutoff policy remain present and labeled when over600s; stopped requests are not recorded as600-second completions. Queuing and model initialization are outside the generation limit.
quality: These are measurement records, not quality scores. Only separately reviewed outputs enter the gallery.
coverage: Observed matrix records, including partial and failed configurations. Not all hardware ran every corpus; initial bringup-only tests and unstarted jobs are not in this CSV. No optimality claim.
candidates: Runtime flags distinguish memory candidates from baselines. MXFP8 is used where supported; Hopper/Ampere use BF16. Ordinary FP8 is excluded.
